result.instructions: Tools for MemberVault, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which courses are in our MemberVault account, and what are their ids?"; "Give jane@example.com access to course 109."; "Remove sam@example.com's access to course 109, but keep the account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MemberVault data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run membervault_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run membervault_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run membervault_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. membervault_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: membervault_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: Lists the products (courses) in the MemberVault account with their ids. Read-only. Call this first: use one of these ids as course_id in the other tools. The vendor documents no reply fields, so the reply is the vendor's JSON as it is. MemberVault API: GET /api/get_courses.

tools.name: membervault_add_user
tools.title: Add a user to a course
tools.description: Adds a user to a course (product). MemberVault finds an existing user with that email and does not create a duplicate, so the call is safe to repeat. Use course_id -1 to add the user with no product access. This changes the account. MemberVault API: GET /api/add_user.

email.description: The user's email address (the user's login in MemberVault).

course_id.description: The course id from membervault_list_courses. Use -1 to add the user with no product access.

first_name.description: The user's first name (used when the user is new).

last_name.description: The user's last name (used when the user is new).

annotations.title: Add a user to a course

tools.name: membervault_remove_user
tools.title: Remove a user's access to a course
tools.description: Removes a user's access to one course (product). The user stays in the MemberVault account, with their other courses and their progress. This changes the account at once. To delete the user entirely, use membervault_delete_user. MemberVault API: GET /api/remove_user.

email.description: The user's email address (the user's login in MemberVault).

course_id.description: The course id from membervault_list_courses (a real course, not -1).

annotations.title: Remove a user's access to a course

tools.name: membervault_delete_user
tools.title: Delete a user (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes a user from the MemberVault account, with all of their data, progress and quiz answers. MemberVault cannot undo it. Only call this when the user must be removed completely; to remove course access only, use membervault_remove_user. MemberVault API: GET /api/delete_user.

email.description: The user's email address (the user's login in MemberVault).
